observations.point: The corrected silent_remedy register and grammar
observations.detail: "/stop अगर यह चुप रहे।" — '/stop' literal (U+002F + ASCII 'stop'), danda U+0964 retained, and चुप रहे is the plain register the neighbouring remedies use (es 'si sigue en silencio', vi 'nếu vẫn im lặng') where the previous चुप्पी बनी रहे was literary. यह + रहे agrees masculine singular with the implied subject (session/agent), which is the Hindi default with no overt head noun. The inverted conditional (main clause first, अगर-clause second) is the pattern Hindi UI copy uses for terse hints; no change requested.
